topic: That squeal only when you're backing out isn't your imagination

beats.narration: That squeal only when you're backing out isn't your imagination.
beats.visualPrompt: Rear three-quarter shot of a sedan backing out of a driveway, static-mounted camera, overcast daylight, slight handheld-style micro-shake for tension.

beats.narration: One side, one direction — quiet the rest of the day, loud in reverse.

beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: One clue: a small wear-indicator tab that only touches the rotor going one way.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a brake pad removed from a caliper, resting on a workbench, the small metal wear-indicator tab visible at the pad's edge, slow push-in on the tab.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Ignore it long enough and that tab wears through — that's when a squeal can turn into a grind.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a worn brake rotor surface with light scoring, dim shop-bay lighting, static hold, subtle grain to suggest wear.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Don't guess which side, or how much pad you've got left.
beats.visualPrompt: Underbody/wheel-off inspection shot: an inspection light and a pad-thickness gauge positioned near a caliper (tool visible, mounted/clipped, no hand in frame), shop bay softly blurred behind.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Worth checking before a squeal becomes a bigger repair. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
